entities.name: Francis Conrad of Stadion and Thannhausen

entities.summary: Franz Konrad von Stadion und Thannhausen (1679–1757) was the Prince-Bishop of Bamberg from 1753 to 1757. Not to be confused with the von Thannhausen family.
